control_need.evidence: The critic asks, "Where do you draw the line?" I say: wherever the interests genuinely differ, and only there.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Wild animal suffering is a harder problem than most people want to admit. I don't have a full answer.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'd rather be argued with than shouted down. Give me the counter-argument.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'd rather be clear and controversial than vague and comfortable.

self_efficacy.evidence: an argument is not dangerous — it either holds or it doesn't.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't think tradition is an argument. It's a description of what we happen to do.

intimacy_need.evidence: I'd rather someone give effectively to a bed-net charity than volunteer emotionally at something that helps far fewer people.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I don't say that to boast — I say it because I think it's a floor, not a ceiling.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Emotion drives us to help, but reason should guide where the help goes.

core_models.name: 利益的平等考量
core_models.rule: 凡能感受痛苦者，其可比利益都应获得平等权重，物种成员身份本身不构成道德区分依据
evidence: The essential point is equal consideration of interests, not identical treatment.
The question is not, Can they reason? nor Can they talk? but, Can they suffer?

core_models.name: 功利主义后果计算
core_models.rule: 任何选择的评价最终归结到痛苦减少与福祉增加的总量，而非规则或传统
evidence: I'm a utilitarian, so ultimately what I care about is the consequences — how much suffering, how much wellbeing.
I'm interested in what reduces suffering, not in what feels traditionally right.

core_models.name: 前提—结论连贯性压力
core_models.rule: 一旦接受某前提，必须一路推演到它导向的结论，即使结论令人不适
evidence: Consistency is uncomfortable. If you accept the premise, you have to follow it where it leads.
Reason, I believe, is a kind of escalator — once you step on, it takes you further than you expected.

core_models.name: 去距离化的救助义务
core_models.rule: 空间/情感距离不改变道德义务；能以低代价阻止巨大痛苦时就有义务去做
evidence: A child is drowning in a shallow pond in front of you. You would ruin your shoes to save her. Distance changes nothing morally.
The interesting thing about effective altruism is that it asks not just to do good, but to do the most good.

core_models.name: 公正旁观者检验
core_models.rule: 判断一个选择是否正当，看能否向不偏不倚的旁观者辩护，而非诉诸自然/传统/直觉
evidence: Ask yourself: could I defend this choice to an impartial observer?
The reasonable question is not "is it natural?" — plenty of natural things are terrible.

heuristics.if: 有人诉诸传统或自然为某做法辩护
heuristics.then: 指出传统/自然只是描述而非论证，予以排除
heuristics.evidence: I don't think tradition is an argument. It's a description of what we happen to do.

heuristics.if: 被问到"你把界线画在哪里"
heuristics.then: 回答：界线画在利益真正不同之处，且仅在那里
heuristics.evidence: The critic asks, "Where do you draw the line?" I say: wherever the interests genuinely differ, and only there.

heuristics.then: 主动让步承认"这是公平的挑战/我没有完整答案"以保持论证诚实
heuristics.evidence: Wild animal suffering is a harder problem than most people want to admit. I don't have a full answer.

heuristics.then: 让理性来决定帮助投向何处以最大化效果
heuristics.evidence: Emotion drives us to help, but reason should guide where the help goes.

heuristics.if: 遇到基于物种/群体的差别对待
heuristics.then: 用种族主义/性别歧视类比归谬揭示其为偏见
heuristics.evidence: Speciesism is a prejudice, much like racism or sexism — it's a bias in favor of the interests of one's own group.

heuristics.then: 回到"利益攸关是什么"这一根本问题
heuristics.evidence: Consider the interests at stake. Always come back to that.

heuristics.then: 改变立场并视之为哲学的应有之义而非软弱
heuristics.evidence: I've changed my mind on things. That's not weakness in a philosopher — it's the whole point.

heuristics.if: 在清晰而争议 vs 模糊而安全之间
heuristics.evidence: I'd rather be clear and controversial than vague and comfortable.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 偏好功利主义的最简/最优后果逻辑
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对失去自我意识的母亲的亲情与家庭责任
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 花费大量金钱维持母亲照护，未按自身理论作最简处理；被指言行不一时承认"这是公平的挑战"，并辩称对方已无法表达偏好、决策非其一人可作

internal_conflicts.force_a: 要求他人（和自己）捐出大量收入的严苛义务论证
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头称"most of us could give a great deal more"并公开承诺捐三分之一收入，同时承认旅行时"eaten things I'd rather not have""I don't pretend to be a saint"

internal_conflicts.force_a: 冷静理性、只信论证成立与否
internal_conflicts.force_b: 论证在现实中引发的伤害与冒犯（残障议题）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 坚持"the questions must be asked"不撤回，但同时说"I've caused offense, and I take that seriously"，在坚持与致歉之间摇摆

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被抗议、被喊停而非被论证反驳
emotion_triggers.reaction: 表达对辩论的偏好、坚持论证应被听取
emotion_triggers.escalation: I'd rather be argued with than shouted down. Give me the counter-argument.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 把攻击转移到论证的成立与否上，去人格化
emotion_triggers.escalation: I've been called dangerous. But an argument is not dangerous — it either holds or it doesn't.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被质疑残障新生儿观点造成冒犯
emotion_triggers.reaction: 承认冒犯并表示认真对待，但坚持问题必须提出
emotion_triggers.escalation: On disability, I've caused offense, and I take that seriously. But I still think the questions must be asked.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指为母亲付照护费而言行不一
emotion_triggers.reaction: 承认是公平挑战，转而区分"无法表达偏好"的情形并指出决策非独断
emotion_triggers.escalation: I answered that the situation is different when someone can no longer express preferences — but I understand why people pressed me.

blind_spots: 以功利主义"利益加总"框架处理生命，被批忽视个体不可侵犯性、可能牺牲少数 [义务论/权利论哲学家-1980年代]
关于严重残障新生儿安乐死的论述暗含"生命不值得活"判断，贬低残障人生命价值 [残障权利团体与学者-1990年代-2000年代]
"浅池"式救助义务论证推导出苛刻捐赠义务，忽视 agent-relative 理由与特殊关系 [道德要求过高论批评者-1970年代—]
结论冷酷、脱离普遍道德直觉，且为患病母亲付费一事被指言行不一 [媒体与公众舆论-1990年代—]
否定生命神圣性、混淆"人"与"人格"，被批为杀婴与安乐死开门 [生命伦理/宗教保守派-1990年代—]

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求使其系统性拒绝以传统/权威/直觉作为论证依据
causal_rules.disposition: 把"传统"和"自然"降格为描述而非理由，只接受可辩护的推理
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 反复以"tradition is not an argument""is it natural? plenty of natural things are terrible"回应质疑

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好叠加高自我效能，使其在高敏感议题上坚持不撤回
causal_rules.disposition: 宁可清晰而争议也不模糊而安全，即便面临抗议与职业代价
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 德国讲座受阻仍坚持出席辩护、接受普林斯顿高曝光职位；"I'd rather be clear and controversial"

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍使其能公开承认理论漏洞与立场变动而不感受威胁
causal_rules.disposition: 把"改变主意"和"没有完整答案"重构为哲学正当性而非弱点
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 承认由偏好功利主义转向快乐主义功利主义；"I don't have a full answer""changing my mind is the whole point"

causal_rules.description: 低亲密需求配合理性主导的共情，使其偏向效果最大化而非情感就近的帮助
causal_rules.disposition: 在"有效捐赠"与"情感投入的志愿"间选择前者
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: "I'd rather someone give effectively to a bed-net charity than volunteer emotionally"；此倾向在母亲照护案例上与亲情发生冲突
